import subprocess, re, os

results = []

            path = os.path.join(root, f)
            with open(path) as fh:
                content = fh.read()
            for m in re.finditer(r'^func\s+(?:\([^)]*\)\s*)?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\s*\(', content, re.MULTILINE):
                name = m.group(1)
                if name[0].isupper():

counts = []
for name, path in results:
    out = subprocess.run(["grep", "-rn", rf"[.\w]{name}\(", "--include=*.go", "."], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    lines = [l for l in out.splitlines() if "_test.go" not in l and "/proto/gen/" not in l]
    # exclude the declaration line itself
    count = len(lines)
    counts.append((count, name, path))

counts.sort(reverse=True)
for c in counts[:30]:
    print(c)
EOF
